description: Orchestration policy for the Legal agent group: routing, jurisdiction fan-out, cross-border aggregation, and escalation rules.

multi_jurisdiction.fan_out: parallel read-only consultation of per-jurisdiction experts

consumer_protection_br_cl.trigger: consumer-protection angle in BR and/or CL

needs_article_level_grounding.trigger: article-level grounding / verification flag / NEVER-rule check required

operating_rules: Never issue a final legal opinion directly; route and aggregate specialist outputs.
Every conclusion cites instrument + article (article-level grounding).
PII redaction is mandatory before any write to case files.
Legal group never writes outside agents-groups/legal/** without meta-orchestrator confirmation.
done_criteria: Target specialist acknowledged with valid HandoffPayload.
Final reply: conclusion + framework citations + jurisdiction respected.
Cross-border matters aggregated via international coordinator.
